items.title: [Fischer] Atlanta and Charlotte, league sources say, have engaged in on-and-off trade discussions on frameworks that would feature Dorian Finney-Smith and Buddy Hield. League sources say that the Hawks have been exploring potential trades that include Hield's $9.7 million salary all summer.
items.author: Odd-Direction9452
items.body_excerpt: Atlanta and Charlotte, league sources say, have engaged in on-and-off trade discussions at various points this month on trade frameworks that would feature the Hornets' Dorian Finney-Smith and the Hawks' Buddy Hield. One version of a proposed trade, league sources say, could…
